reviews.x: My son wanted these combs and was very happy with them. He had found some other combs like these on another site, but they were mostly plastic and cost more. Glad we checked Amazon before we made the purchase.

reviews.t: Looks good did come with two
reviews.x: Cool, a little light, comb is short and has a safety slider like a real switchblade

reviews.t: Great prop for theatre and musicals!  Stage Manager approved!
reviews.x: Great prop for a musical we produced.  Always buy extras as this technically is a novelty toy, and they get lost easy  They functions perfectly and really looks like a real switchblade onstage. If you like, you could paint the black comb with metallic silver paint.  Just use a thin coat, don't get any paint in the hinge and let it dry completely before closing.  There is also the slide lock which does function and locks the blade.  We have never had issues, but you tape tape it open to prevent a

reviews.t: bought one for my brother and one for my brother-in-law ...
reviews.x: bought one for my brother and one for my brother-in-law. Unfortunately these are constructed entirely of cheap plastic and I do not expect them to last long. However, I still gave it 4 stars because there is absolutely nothing anyone can do to keep from laughing when looking at you trying to be tough with a switchblade comb
These are so fun! Not thick comb and a bit flimsy, but for the price they are great! Husband loved them!

reviews.t: By far the worst piece of garbage I have ever bought
reviews.x: I should have listened to the reviews below. I figured its only 5 bucks for two, but its not even worth that much. By far the worst piece of garbage I have ever bought. The thing practicaly fell apart as soon as I took it out of th ebox. The switch was hit or miss, the blade didn't always snap back into place. The construction was HORRIBLE. There is not an atom of metal on this thing. Again, worst piece of garbage ever.

They're cheap, but it's not like you're paying too much for these things.  They're great for a white elephant gift or re-enacting that scene from "Better Off Dead".  You know, the scene where the paper boy shows up at Lane's door asking for 2 dollars.  He asks for his money, then Lane says "I don't have a dime" and then he says, "I didn't ask for a dime, I asked for two dollars".  Then he whips out the switchblade come and runs it through his hair.  Classic scene.  Add a

The product is a little flimsy but that's OK. It does its job. The switchblade mechanism actually works really well, surprisingly. I'm very happy with this purchase. Oh and shipping was SUPER quick. I came in 3 days!!

feels very plasticy and not sturdy whatsoever. The material feels like a toy. The comb is simply okay. I wouldn't recommend it if you are serious about haircare. Good as a kids toy if you're that kind of parent who lets your kid play with pretend switchblades.

reviews.t: but loads of fun and though the teeth are a bit fine and ...
reviews.x: A little more cheaply constructed than I was expecting, but loads of fun and though the teeth are a bit fine and shallow, they're not plagued by sharp plastic leftover from the molding process. Great gift idea, or cheap, fun pocket comb option.  Just don't take it to school, for obvious reasons.
Exactly what I was looking for.  I needed an actual switchblade knife prop for a play.  I bought this, shaved off the top into a point and spray painted it with metallic silver.  Perfect!
Extremely flimsy material that basically falls apart after a day of use. Would definitely not recommend.
THIS IS NOT STAINLESS STEEL. they can all dangly, plastic, and not worth the money AT ALL.

reviews.t: Takes me back to being a kid
reviews.x: I remember how popular these were when I was a kid in school. I always wanted one to carry around. I bought a double pack, 1 for my son and the other for the kid still inside. lol. These are good quality and are just as fun today as they were when I was a kid. The spring is good quality and although I have used is a lot, it still continues to work just like when I got it. If I had to knitpick one thing, it would be there is a lock that can be used to make the unit not open. That lock can get in

The product you get for such a low price Is well worth it. These combs are more durable than you'd expect for the cost, although the locking mechanism doesn't work very well. When slid up towards the release button, it locks the button from pressing. However, the locking mechanism tends to slide freely, so it is not very reliable. The comb itself is made of plastic, but as long as this product is treated with care, I believe it to be fairly sturdy. When ordering this product, I asked for it to b

reviews.t: these are more of a gag gift than a real good comb. From what I can tell
reviews.x: These combs were purchased for my son. According to him, these are more of a gag gift than a real good comb.  From what I can tell, they are fairly well made but the materials aren't extra high quality.  The push button and eject work mostly without incident, occasionally getting stuck, but not regularly.  The comb portion itself is VERY shallow, so if you have thick hair, you're unlikely to be able to use it as a comb.  I would recommend these for a fun gift or maybe as a prop, but if you're lo

reviews.t: Nice switch blade comb for the money.
reviews.x: I had one of these when I was a kid so I bought these for my boys. My 10 year old took his to school and got suspended even though this is not a knife. The zero tolerance idiocy in our schools strikes again. I guess it look enough like a knife when closed to trigger the snowflake idiot teachers. For the price this is a good deal, keeping in mind it is a cheap novelty and not intended to be anything more.

These things are awesome and cheap and you get two!!! It's so funny to watch how people react when I start to take this out of my pocket and start to pull it out on them. It's a good joke at work but be careful where you do it or else you might get shot. My advice is to not do it on strangers. Moreover, it's actually a pretty handy comb that actually works.

Horrible! Switches and buttons broken in just hours. My son is so disappointed. These aren’t even worth 2 for 5 bucks. It takes $4.99 to ship them back for replacement.... so we are stuck with junk and no replacement... don’t waste your time or money, we will be buying a nicer switchblade comb. This is trash.

Cheap gag, but a nice little comb for folks with short hair. It's actually pretty cool. I gave my dad the other comb, & he got a kick out of it. He's been carrying it everywhere. All in all, a fun thing to have.

reviews.t: A good cheap comb from yesteryear.
reviews.x: These are just like the ones I got as a kid.  They are cheaply made and look cheap but that's not a detraction, that's to be expected for the price point.  The box they come in is pretty neat as well.
Its a good product to buy if you are into old novelty things. I don't use it so much, I just like to admire it and make my friends freak out and making them think I have a real switch blade.
Product was exactly how pictured,  and exactly how I remember it when it was when I was a kid, shipping was on decent time will do business with them again
They work great. Nice comb on it but I will say when I use it im careful with it because it feels like it could break easy.
My son had to have these combs!  They very much look like a switch blade, but really it's a comb!  Fun, novel item.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the combs fun and a good value for the low price, often buying them as gifts.
Several reviewers describe the combs as flimsy or cheaply made plastic, with some reporting they fall apart.
Reviewers frequently praise the working switchblade mechanism and its realistic look, making it a popular prop for theatre and plays.
Some reviewers note issues with the locking mechanism or switch being unreliable.
